connector.name: Lockally Email
connector.registryDescription: Stateful email for AI agents - read inboxes, reply in-thread, draft with approval.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.lockally.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.lockally. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Your Lockally API key (lk_live_... or lk_test_...) as a Bearer token
